label: RUCKUS ICX 8200-24ZP (24x 2.5G PoE+++, 740 W, 4x 25G SFP28)
description: RUCKUS ICX 8200-24ZP stackable multigigabit PoE switch: 24x 100/1000/2500BASE-T RJ-45 802.3af/at/bt PoE+++ up to 90 W (740 W budget), 4x 1/10/25G SFP28 uplink/stacking cages, 320 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: 740 W of 802.3bt across 24 multigigabit downlinks. Data sheet maximums: 24 ports at 15.4 W or 30 W (Class 3/4), 12 ports at 60 W (Class 6), 8 ports at 90 W (Class 8) - 8 x 90 W = 720 W is what the 740 W supply carries. FastIron 10.0.20 PoE matrix: 4-pair ports 1-24 at 90 W, 802.3bt Type-4, PoH/overdrive 1-24 at 120 W on LLDP request.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 320 Gbps (data rate, full duplex); forwarding capacity 237 Mpps.

notes: Multigigabit edge box for Wi-Fi 6E/7 APs: 24 x 2.5G RJ-45 downlinks, each a 4-pair 802.3bt Type-4 PSE up to 90 W, on a 740 W budget that runs 8 ports at 90 W or 12 at 60 W - not 24 at either. Fixed PSU and fans; the redundant sibling is the 48ZP2 (32x 1G PoE+ plus 16x 2.5G PoE+++, 800 W per PSU). Downlink speeds are 100M/1G/2.5G only: this model has no 5G or 10G copper port. PoE matrix: https://docs.ruckusnetworks.com/prod/ruckus-docs/fastiron-10020-managementguide/$/PoESupportMatrixGUID-5F3A189B-9A72-418A-AEA6-96FDC67978333en-US. Chassis: single integrated power supply and fans (no redundant PSU), one RJ-45 Ethernet out-of-band management port, one RJ-45 serial console port and one USB Type-C console port, one USB port for external storage. Serial console is fixed at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control; the RJ-45 pinout is pin 3 TXD, pin 6 RXD, pin 4 ground. Boot firmware: 16 MB SPI flash holding two boot images (dual boot), 4 GB DDR4 main memory, 8 GB eMMC NAND. Stacking: up to 12 switches per stack over the SFP28 uplinks (1.2 Tbps aggregate stacking bandwidth; 10 km maximum stacking distance). Layer 3: static routing and RIP in the base image; OSPF, VRRP, VRF, GRE, PIM, PBR, BGP and VXLAN need the ICX8200-PREM-LIC premium licence, so this is modelled as l3-forward with no licence claim. Management: RUCKUS One, SmartZone, or controllerless Unleashed; the box also carries a CLI. Software: FastIron 10.0.20 is the train the ICX 8200 documentation set is published against (FastIron Management Configuration Guide 10.0.20). Sources: ICX 8200 data sheet (PA-117001.3-EN) https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/globalassets/digizuite/993200-RUCKUS-ICX-8200-Switch-Data-Sheet.pdf; ICX 8200 Technical Specifications, part 53-1005761-03, 15 October 2024 https://docs.ruckusnetworks.com/prod/ruckus-pdfs/icx8200-technicalspecification; product page https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/products/ethernet-switches/itemicx8200-24zp/.
